newsitem.title: USA: Aquila unveils website for muni, stock funds.
newsitem.headline: Aquila unveils website for muni, stock funds.

text.p: Aquila Management Corp said it introduced a web site to allow investors to get information on Aquila Mutual Funds -- including seven single-state municipal bonds funds -- via the Internet.

"The new web site has been designed to provide our Aquila shareholders and prospective investors fast and easy acess to a wide variety of information on our funds," Aquila Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Lacy Herrmann said a company release.

Featured funds will include Aquila's Churchill Tax-Free Fund of Kentucky, Hawaiian Tax-Free Trust, Narragansett Insured Tax-Free Income Fund, Tax-Free Fund for Utah, Tax-Free Fund of Colorado, Tax-Free Trust of Arizona and Tax-Free Trust of Oregon. The Narragansett fund invests in Rhode Island debt.

The Web site will also include information on two regional stock funds: The Aquila Rocky Mountain Equity Fund, which invests in businesses with a significant presence in eight Rocky Mountain States, and the Aquila Cascadia Equity Fund, which invests in seven Northwestern States.

Web site information includes daily yield and price quotes, monthly portfolio characteristics, tax equivalent yield tables, hypothetical illustrations, and on-line prospectuses, which may also be downloaded. The site also provides answers to frequently asked questions about Aquila's funds and other relevant information. Data will be updated daily.
Aquila Group of Funds runs 14 funds with a total of slightly less than $3 billion under management.
